title: Shopper Earnings Terms — Long-Distance Threshold by Shopper Level and Length of Service, Cartwise Shopper Batches
content:
**Condition.** The long-distance threshold that applies to a batch of Cartwise Shopper Batches — the distance the estimated route shown on the offer must exceed for the long-distance bonus to be due — follows the shopper's contractor account in Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts:

(a) **8.0 miles** for a shopper account at the Gold level or above (Full-Service Shopper Gold, Platinum or Diamond) that is **36 or more** whole calendar months past its first activation date;

(b) **9.0 miles** for a shopper account at the Silver level or above (Full-Service Shopper Silver, Gold, Platinum or Diamond) that is **12 to 35** whole calendar months past its first activation date;

(c) the batch type's own long-distance threshold for every other account.

A batch type whose own long-distance threshold is zero (the Shop-Only Batch and the Express 30 Batch) carries no long-distance bonus at all, whatever the account's level and length of service.

## Records read

The account's level and its first activation date, both from the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record; the months are whole calendar months from the first activation date to the handling date.

## Condition matrix

| Account level | Whole calendar months since first activation | Threshold that applies |
|---|---|---|
| Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 36 or more | 8.0 miles |
| Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 12 to 35 | 9.0 miles |
| Silver | 12 to 35 | 9.0 miles |
| Silver | 36 or more | The batch type's own threshold |
| Any level | Fewer than 12 | The batch type's own threshold |
| Shop-Only Shopper or Full-Service Shopper | Any | The batch type's own threshold |

Both parts of each condition must hold: a Silver account 40 months past activation meets neither (a) nor (b).

## Boundaries (hypothetical accounts)

- A Gold account 36 whole months past activation: 8.0 miles. The same account at 35 whole months: 9.0 miles.
- A Silver account at 12 whole months: 9.0 miles; at 11 whole months: the batch type's own threshold.
- On a Double Delivery Batch with an estimated route of 8.6 miles, a Diamond account 50 months past activation has a threshold of 8.0 miles, which 8.6 exceeds; a route of exactly 8.0 miles would not exceed it.
